en.title: Plurals: one and many
en.teach: Most words add -s for more than one: one cat, two cats. Words ending in s, x, sh or ch add -es: one fox, two foxes. Some are special: one mouse, two mice.

reasons.s: Most words just add -s: one {one}, two {answer}.
reasons.es: Words ending in s, x, sh or ch add -es: one {one}, two {answer}.
reasons.o-es: Some words ending in o add -es: one {one}, two {answer}.
reasons.ies: A consonant and y at the end change to -ies: one {one}, two {answer}.
reasons.ves: Some words ending in f or fe change to -ves: one {one}, two {answer}.
reasons.same: Some words stay the same: one {one}, two {answer}.
reasons.special: This one is special, to learn by heart: one {one}, two {answer}.
